science_goal: What mechanisms set the depth of a planet-carved gap in a protoplanetary disc?

gap_opening_mass_thermal.formula: M_gap_th = 3 * M_star * h^3  (R_Hill = H condition: q = 3h^3)
gap_opening_mass_thermal.note: Hill sphere equals scale height; gap onset criterion

gap_opening_mass_viscous_Kanagawa.formula: M_gap_visc = M_star * sqrt(K_open * h^5 * alpha), K_open=25

Sigma_gap_over_Sigma_0.note: ~118x gas depletion in gap; Kanagawa+2016 eq.4

stability_criteria.name: Thermal gap-opening (Hill sphere)
stability_criteria.ref_bibcode: NOT FABRICATED — see Crida+2006; 2006Icar..181..587C [VERIFY IN ADS]

predicted_observables.name: Gas gap depth
predicted_observables.formula_ref: Kanagawa+2016 eq.4 [2016PASJ...68...43K]; calibrated on 2D isothermal hydro; 3D/non-isothermal corrections ~20-30% (see hypotheses warnings)

predicted_observables.name: Dust gap depth (mm continuum)
predicted_observables.uncertainty: order-of-magnitude; depends on Stokes number and v_frag (Hypothesis 1)
predicted_observables.formula_ref: Stokes trapping efficiency; requires DustPy run

nonlinear_trigger: K = 2916 >> K_open = 25;  q/q_visc = 10.8;  q/(3h^3) = 2.55.  All three dimensionless ratios >> 1.  The Kanagawa formula is empirically calibrated from 2D isothermal simulations up to K ~ O(1000).  At K ~ 3000 the formula is approaching its calibration boundary; predictions carry an additional ~30% systematic uncertainty.  Gap edges at this depth may trigger the Rossby Wave Instability (Hypothesis 2).

parameter_recommendations.resolution: Minimum 512x1024 (r x phi) to resolve gap width ~ R_H = 0.11 au at 20 au; Δr < R_H/5
parameter_recommendations.wave_killing_zone: Apply wave-killing for r < 2 au and r > 150 au to suppress spurious reflections
parameter_recommendations.time_integration: Run to t > 1000 orbits at 20 au (~89,000 yr) to reach gap steady state; check gap depth convergence at t=500 and t=1000
parameter_recommendations.alpha_range_for_Hyp2: Span alpha = [1e-4, 3e-4, 1e-3, 3e-3] to bracket alpha* ~ 3e-4 (RWI threshold)
parameter_recommendations.Sigma_floor: Set Sigma_floor = 1e-5 Sigma_0 to prevent numerical issues in the deep gap

warnings: Kanagawa formula 0.04 prefactor calibrated on 2D isothermal hydro; 3D/non-isothermal corrections may shift results 20-30% (see hypothesis file warnings)
K = 2916 is near/above the empirical calibration range of the Kanagawa formula; treat Sigma_gap/Sigma_0 = 8.5e-3 as a lower bound (actual gap may be slightly shallower)
Gap edges at K >> 25 likely exceed RWI threshold — dust ring morphology may be azimuthally asymmetric (relevant to Hypothesis 2)
